Thanks for telling me, Nadia. I'll keep it between us. I won't bring it up in any channel or with anyone else, including Ruth, unless you ask me to in a way that doesn't reveal what you shared.

If Ruth needs to know about Vantorre's plans, the right route is for you or Mateo to brief her directly. I can help you set that up, for example by sending her a calendar invite or a short note, if you tell me what you want to say.
